T: The frat's next door. So are the snacks.
D: A young couple with a baby go to war with the fraternity that moves in next door.
P: Serve the snacks when the frat throws its first party.
S: Frat party pork and fennel sausage rolls
Pork, apple and fennel sausage rolls in puff pastry

Flaky puff pastry rolls filled with pork, fennel seed and apple, sprinkled with sesame and served with a smoky tomato relish. Mix 500g pork sausage mince with 1 grated apple, 1 grated onion, 2 tsp crushed fennel seeds, 30g breadcrumbs and pepper. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry in half. Lay a log of filling along each strip, roll up and seal underneath. Brush with 1 beaten egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and cut each into 4. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden. Serve with 200g tomato relish stirred with 1/2 tsp smoked paprika.
Baby Stella date night baked brie
Baked brie with honey thyme walnuts, baguette toasts and grapes

A whole brie baked until molten, topped with honey, toasted walnuts and thyme, served with crunchy toasts and grapes for dunking. Unwrap a 200g brie wheel, score the top in a criss-cross and sit it in a small ovenproof dish. Bake at 180C for 12 minutes until soft and molten. Meanwhile toast 50g walnuts in a dry pan for 4 minutes and warm them with 2 tbsp honey and a few thyme leaves. Spoon over the hot brie. Slice 1 baguette thinly, brush with oil and bake 8 minutes. Serve with the toasts and 300g grapes.
M: Grilled rump with parsley chimichurri, corn, sausages and apple slaw

Chargrilled rump steak and pork sausages with a sharp herb chimichurri, served with grilled corn and a crunchy apple slaw. Blitz 1 bunch parsley, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes, 3 tbsp red wine vinegar and 100ml olive oil. Grill 4 corn cobs for 10 minutes, turning. Grill 8 pork sausages for 12 minutes. Season 800g rump steak and grill over high heat for 4 minutes a side, then rest 5 minutes and slice. Toss shredded cabbage and 1 julienned apple with 3 tbsp mayonnaise and lemon. Spoon chimichurri over the steak.
W: Teddy and Pete's funfetti sheet cake
Vanilla sprinkle cake with cream cheese frosting

A soft vanilla sheet cake baked with rainbow sprinkles through the crumb, covered in thick cream cheese frosting and more sprinkles. Beat 200g soft butter with 250g caster sugar until pale. Beat in 3 eggs and 2 tsp vanilla, then fold in 300g self-raising flour and 200ml milk. Fold through 60g rainbow sprinkles. Spread into a lined 23 x 33cm tin and bake at 180C for 30 minutes. Cool. Beat 250g cream cheese with 80g butter and 300g icing sugar until fluffy, spread over the cake and finish with more sprinkles.
K: White rum, pineapple juice, passionfruit and lime in a big bowl

White rum, pineapple and passionfruit juice with lime and lemonade, poured over ice with orange slices and fresh mint. In a big jug or punch bowl, mix 1L pineapple juice, the pulp of 4 passionfruit, the juice of 2 limes and 200ml white rum. Chill for 30 minutes. Just before serving, add 1L cold lemonade, 2 sliced oranges and plenty of ice. Stir gently and scatter with mint. Make a second jug without rum for anyone not drinking.

dishes.n: Frat party pork and fennel sausage rolls

steps.text: Mix the sausage mince with the apple, onion, fennel, breadcrumbs and pepper.
Cut the pastry in half. Lay a log of filling along each strip, roll up and seal underneath.
Brush with egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and cut each roll into pieces.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Stir the paprika into the relish and serve alongside.

dishes.n: Baby Stella date night baked brie

steps.text: Score the top of the brie in a criss-cross and sit it in a small ovenproof dish.
Brush the baguette slices with oil and bake at 180C alongside the brie until crisp. Remove the toasts first.
Toast the walnuts in a dry pan, then warm with the honey and thyme leaves.
Spoon the nuts over the hot brie and serve with the toasts and grapes.
Blitz the parsley, garlic, oregano, chilli, vinegar and oil into chimichurri.
Grill the corn, turning.
Grill the sausages.
Season the steak and grill over high heat, then rest and slice.
Toss the cabbage and apple with the mayonnaise and lemon juice.
Spoon the chimichurri over the steak and serve with corn, sausages and slaw.

dishes.n: Teddy and Pete's funfetti sheet cake

steps.text: Beat most of the butter with the sugar until pale. Beat in the eggs and vanilla, then fold in the flour and milk.
Fold through some of the sprinkles and spread into a lined 23 x 33cm tin.
Bake at 180C and cool completely.
Beat the cream cheese with the remaining butter and icing sugar until fluffy.
Spread over the cake and finish with more sprinkles.
Mix the pineapple juice, passionfruit pulp, lime juice and rum in a big jug or bowl.
Chill.
Just before serving, add the lemonade, orange slices and plenty of ice. Stir gently and scatter with mint.
